title: [Feature Request]: IBM WatsonxLLM doesn't support `persistent_connection` configurable
body:
### Feature Description

IBM watsonx Python SDK added the `persistent_connection` flag in 1.1.2 and enabled it by default. This causes problems with certain environments where network connections are cut from time to time, such as OpenShift/Kubernetes. There should be a way to disable it in llama_index.

### Reason

It is not possible to disable the persistent connection via llama_index today.

### Value of Feature

_No response_

linked_prs.title: WatsonxLLM/WatsonxEmbeddings: persistent_connection configurable
linked_prs.body:
# Description

In the IBM watsonx Python SDK, persistent connections were enabled in
version 1.1.2 and higher. However, this causes problems in some
environments where network connections are cut from time to time. This
creates a connection error and the inference fails.

Add a `persistent_connection` boolean for the WatsonxLLM class set to
True by default (to match upstream), but allow it to be disabled if
needed.

Fixes #18400
